Agent 33/35 — numeric/extreme-state safety for digital steering and tires. Exercise zero speed, reverse, near-zero forward velocity with lateral motion, 250+ km/h, NaN/Infinity guards, airborne wheels, spin >90deg sideslip and post-crash recovery. Ensure no divide-by-zero, discontinuous full-lock unlock or invalid tire forces. Preserve normal behavior; patch only robustness defects with focused tests.
